verdict.rationale: Langfuse's docs list "Block deploys on regressions" via a dedicated CI/CD experiments guide. That guide says experiments run in the CI/CD pipeline "to catch quality regressions before they ship." These experiments run against Datasets, can be triggered via the SDK (`run_experiment`), and can be compared to decide whether a change is ready to ship. missing for 10: concrete evidence of the gating mechanism (e.g., threshold assertions or pipeline-failure semantics), independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
